newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total-KOC deal concerns Kuwait-Saudi neutral zone.
newsitem.headline: Total-KOC deal concerns Kuwait-Saudi neutral zone.

text.p: A spokeswoman for French oil group Total SA confirmed on Wednesday that the first applications of a technical assistance deal with Kuwait Oil Company (KOC) would concern the so-called "neutral zone" in the south of the country.
Earlier, Total said it had signed a three-and-a half year agreement with KOC to provide technical knowledge and support regarding KOC's upstream petroleum operations.

A spokesman had declined to comment on reports that Total would be involved in developing the al-Wafta oil field, which is within the zone where both Kuwait and Saudi Arabia have claims on oil reserves.
The Total spokeswoman said the company hoped to be involved in more oil fields. She said Total was the third oil company to sign a similar deal with KOC after Chevron and British Petroleum Plc.
